correctness.rationale: For the pair of ordinary tetrahedral discrete-Morse matching complexes (F,B), enumerate S4 subgroups as generated permutation closures and represent fixed loci by orbit-barycenter simplex complexes; this is necessary because fixed points need not be pointwise fixed original vertices. Independently reconstructed all 30 subgroups; 29 nontrivial subgroup inclusions collapse by exact relative maximal-free-face pairs: six transposition subgroups each 42, eight one-fixed-label groups each two, remaining fifteen zero. For a top Hasse pair e_i its link consists of 2122 augmented faces with vector (1,21,162,560,846,468,64), admitting 1049 acyclic matching pairs including empty and 24 critical degree-3 faces. Relative chains split over four incompatible top-pair stars, so integral H4(F,B)=Z96 and other relative groups vanish. Nonidentity subgroup fixed-set Euler characteristics are equal, making rational H4 trace zero for all nonidentity g; identity trace 96, precisely 4 regular Q[S4] modules. The finite subgroup and link enumerations were independently implemented and topologically sorted, not merely accepted from logs.
